candidate: Monthly observed mountain-hare detection reappearance across 46 fixed Mont-Blanc camera sites

published_aggregate_evidence.source: Bison et al. 2024 Wildlife Biology DOI 10.1002/wlb3.01186 and Dryad README
published_aggregate_evidence.note: The paper fixes 46 cameras, monthly primary occasions, six five-day secondary occasions, 2018-2022 coverage, and observed detected/non-detected semantics, but does not publish the planned calibration/heldout zero-to-positive and zero-to-zero counts.

source_identity.file_identity: exact filename + byte size + SHA-256 for all six version files

node_geometry.registry_rule: the 46 physical camerainfo.csv rows have unique exact Station values and unique coordinate pairs
node_geometry.distance_semantics: Haversine great-circle distance with Earth radius 6371008.8 m, derived only from response-independent coordinates

survey_effort.active_day_rule: calendar days on or after setup_date minus the inclusive union of every ProblemX_from..ProblemX_to interval with both dates present
survey_effort.problem_description_role: audit only; a missing ProblemX description does not erase a complete dated interval

response_semantics.risk_set: closed-registry station with at least 20 response-independent active camera days and zero released mountain-hare contact dates in source month t, followed by at least 20 active days in target month t+1
response_semantics.event: risk-set station has at least one released unique contact date in target month t+1
response_semantics.non_event: risk-set station has zero released contact dates in target month t+1
response_semantics.source_state: all closed-registry stations with at least 20 active days and at least one released unique contact date in source month t
response_semantics.contact_day_intensity: number of unique released Station-Date identities in the source month; used only as a lagged source weight
response_semantics.duplicate_response_rows: exact duplicate Station-Date rows collapse to one observed contact day; raw and unique counts remain audited
response_semantics.absence_basis: zero is inferred only for station-months with at least 20 active days under the response-independent camera problem ledger
response_semantics.date_parser: slash tokens are strict DD/MM/YYYY; hyphen tokens are strict ISO YYYY-MM-DD; no other format or alias is accepted
response_semantics.missingness: blank, invalid, unknown-station, out-of-range, or pre-setup response identities cause terminal schema/identity STOP; no alias repair or carry-forward
response_semantics.boundary: observed camera-station detection reappearance, not latent occupancy, abundance, demographic immigration, parentage, or reconstructed seasonal migration
response_semantics.categorical_token_schema: Station must exactly match the closed nonresponse registry

temporal_split.fit_policy: fit exactly once on pooled eligible calibration risk rows; never refit on heldout outcomes
temporal_split.sequential_layer_a_policy: each month is designed and scored from sources and surviving worlds available before its target response; target outcomes update Layer A only after that month and before the next month

count_gate.failure_action: write immutable non-estimable result with zero fits and zero heldout scores

process_source.system: 46 fixed camera stations on five elevation gradients in the French Mont-Blanc massif
process_source.conditioning_boundary: the predictive claim is conditional on currently recorded, adequately observed internal station sources
process_source.external_sources: not represented; an observed monthly reappearance is not interpreted as physical immigration
process_source.persistence: same-station possible-source persistence is admitted when the next month has at least 20 active days
process_source.transition_relation: the full-support exponential world permits every distinct internal station pair; hard worlds remain falsifiable submodels
process_source.claim_limit: monthly internal source-conditioned predictive support for observed camera contacts, not individual movement or seasonal migration reconstruction

world_scale.axis: response-independent WGS84 Haversine station distance in meters
world_scale.duplicate_lcc_policy: identical raw LCC thresholds are represented once; the 0.75 and 0.90 targets share geo_lcc750_900
world_scale.kernel_scale_basis: the response-blind 50-percent LCC threshold; an analytical decay scale, not a fitted movement distance
world_scale.threshold_interpretation: minimal response-blind structural LCC regimes, not fitted dispersal limits

layer_a_rules.current_sources: all adequately observed camera stations detected in source month t
layer_a_rules.source_weights: equal normalized weight across current internal sources
layer_a_rules.hard_world_support: exp(-distance/kernel_scale) for distinct pairs at or below the frozen LCC threshold, otherwise zero
layer_a_rules.full_world_support: exp(-distance/kernel_scale) for every distinct station pair
layer_a_rules.transition_normalization: Q[s,j]=W[s,j]/(1+sum_k W[s,k]); target support is the equal-current-source mean of Q[s,j]
layer_a_rules.update: after each observed transition, eliminate a surviving rule if any newly detected risk-set target has support at or below 1e-15
layer_a_rules.monotonicity: worlds may only remain or be eliminated; eliminated worlds never return
layer_a_rules.all_eliminated: stop and report frozen-universe falsification without scale or source rescue

comparators.baseline: frozen strong random forest with calendar season, terrain/habitat/camera, geometry, effort, conventional source-distance exposure, and lagged contact-day predictors
comparators.augmented: the identical frozen learner and identical conventional predictors plus the unchanged ten-column Layer-B block

preprocessing_model_fit.missing_value_policy: no predictor imputation; any nonfinite calibration or heldout predictor stops before fit
